note: Two columns, checked against the page image. Page school central-office, decided by heading line 2 (SUPERINTENDENT OF SCHOOLS) and line 11 (CLERICAL STAFF/SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE) for the left-column Allard, Welch and, in the right column, Manooshian and Davis (printed under that heading). Line 2 holds the heading in the left column and Garvey in the right, so it is in both headings and entries; line 11 likewise. Right-column Garvey (line 2) and Withington (line 10) head the right column BEFORE the PASSIOS heading (line 16), so by reading order (left column ends at the Turkey Hill heading, lines 54-55, with Foley) they continue the Turkey Hill administration section: school turkey-hill, a reading-order inference; Withington's printed title says Middle School Principal, Garvey's title just says Administrative Assistant to Principal (hours '5/7ths time' and 'Effective 2/5/79' left out). Lines 15-16 right-column headings 'ADMINISTRATION & CLERICAL STAFF/ PASSIOS ELEMENTARY SCHOOL/LUNENBURG PRIMARY' name two buildings at once, so Verge (17), Finneron (23), Ruggles (28), White (33) get district-wide; Dubzinski (50, Guidance K-5, 'Trans. from H.S. to Elem. Sch.') likewise district-wide. Left lines 26-27 heading decides Peterson, Crouse, Sulin, Walker as high (Walker listed under the HS administration block). Lines 54-55 heading decides Foley as turkey-hill. Guidance heading line 41 (right column): Bissell high from 'Grades 9-12'; Falcone turkey-hill from 'Grades 6-8' and 'Mathematics Teacher, Grade 8' - school taken from the printed grade range matching the Turkey Hill principal's 'Grs. 6-8' (line 56-57). 'Dr.' dropped from names Allard and Peterson (tokens still on the line). Principal lines print '(Grs. ...)' and '(replacing Mr. ...)': omitted. Everything else (education, dates, 'Began' lines, title and page number lines 1 and 63) ignored.
